listing.name: The Catacomb Abyss (CatacombGL)
listing.summary: Use The Catacomb Abyss with its upstream CatacombGL Windows player and your own matching original game files. Setup and updates stay upstream-owned.

steps.title: Keep the correct original game folder
steps.instruction: Use your owned Catacombs Pack Abyss folder or the upstream-documented Abyss shareware v1.13. The shareware route supplies only Abyss. Keep the complete original folder and its companion files. CatacombGL can find a GOG Windows installation; otherwise use its own folder picker. Original data is separate from the player and remains yours.

steps.title: Use the upstream beta player
steps.instruction: Choose Preview for the official Windows 64-bit beta ZIP, extract it and keep CatacombGL.exe and SDL2.dll together. Register CatacombGL.exe with that folder as its working directory. Leave arguments empty for the game picker, or use the single documented argument --abyss after the original folder is recognized. The separate --abyss_sw13 argument selects shareware v1.13. Registration does not start it; choose Play deliberately. The Linux tar.xz needs upstream/system extraction and a prepared native player; the Windows recommendation does not promise managed tar.xz handling.

steps.title: Preserve this engine’s profile
steps.instruction: Windows normally keeps CatacombGL.ini and game-specific data under the actual Roaming AppData/CatacombGL folder. A custom --ini or --log location stays external. Preserve the whole profile, existing game save folders and original data with all copies closed before updating. Controls are shared by all four games. Upstream v0.5.7 documents no controller support and no save compatibility with the original DOS games. ReflectionHLE is a separate implementation; do not move saves between them on the basis of a shared game title.

steps.title: Keep upstream update ownership
steps.instruction: You and upstream maintain this external player, original files and profile. Portcove offers explicit registration, supervised Play and registration-only removal; it does not acquire ownership of the external files or offer managed Update, Backup, Rollback or deletion. Keep a working copy and back up its actual data before an upstream update. Other platforms need their own supported upstream package/application flow; this Windows guide does not establish native execution on any platform.

warnings: The reviewed CatacombGL release is beta. Original DOS save compatibility and controller support are not offered by this version.
